description: Parameters consumed by the publish artifacts stage. Vendor overrides may suppress, replace, or extend these via a vendor-scripts/16-publish.params.json in the config repo.

parameterGroups.name: Stage Selections
parameterGroups.description: Boolean flags that control which pipeline stages are enabled. All stage-gate parameters are collected here so operators can see and adjust the full execution plan in one place.

parameters.name: PUBLISH_ARTIFACTS
parameters.description: Publish built artifacts to the release repository. Disabled by default — enable only for official nightly, weekly, or release builds. Publishing is irreversible; ensure the build is validated before enabling.
